cards.title_html: Cập Nhật Mới (Face DNA - Anh Việt)
cards.desc_html:
1. COOK ERA: Style cinematic tối kịch tính, chữ mạ vàng, đúng khuôn mặt Face DNA.
2. PODCAST (NO TEXT): Thay nhân vật nam bằng Face DNA anh Việt mặc áo vàng, người bên phải giữ nguyên, không text.

Phân tích góc máy & ánh sáng: Góc máy Chest-up, ánh sáng viền Neon Cyan và Purple, không gian background Server Rack tối màu, thần thái tự tin, đeo kính gọng tròn. 3 Phong cách Banner Face DNA anh Việt: (1) Style 1 • 20+ AI AGENTS AUTOMATION KEYNOTE, (2) Style 2 • 20+ AI AGENTS AUTOMATION KEYNOTE, (3) Style 3 • 20+ AI AGENTS AUTOMATION KEYNOTE.

cards.title_html: Kiểu 2 - Sản Phẩm Cao Cấp (Huawei XT2 Showcase)
cards.desc_html: Phân tích góc máy & ánh sáng: Trung cảnh ngang thắt lưng (medium waist-up framing), tỷ lệ người chuẩn keynote công nghệ. Phông nền studio xám xanh (cool slate grey minimal architectural panels) với đường chỉ dọc tinh tế. Ánh sáng studio mềm (soft diffused commercial key light), viền rim light tách nền sắc sảo. 5 Phong cách Banner Face DNA anh Việt: (1) Navy Suit Keynote Classic, (2) Charcoal Dark Minimalist OLED, (3) Slate Grey Bespoke, (4) Midnight Executive Collar, (5) Titanium Glasses Z-Fold.

cards.title_html: Kiểu 9 - Văn Phòng Tech Startup (Làm Việc Nhóm)
cards.desc_html: People in an office environment, casual tech startup vibe, bright daylight. | A medium waist-up framing of the man leaning forward over a desk, looking intently down at a laptop screen alongside two other people. He is wearing a simple black t-shirt with a logo. The background is a brightly lit, modern office environment with glass partitions and natural daylight.

cards.title_html: Kiểu 10 - Sân Khấu Màn Hình LED Khổng Lồ
cards.desc_html: A medium full-body framing (knee-up) of the man standing on a stage, hands clasped together in front of him. He is wearing a dark navy blazer over a black shirt. The background features a large glowing presentation screen showing a sunset and two motorcycles, with silhouettes of an audience sitting in the foreground.

cards.title_html: Kiểu 11 - Cafe Sáng Đọc Báo (Phong Cách Denim)
cards.desc_html: A medium waist-up shot of the man sitting casually outdoors, holding a paper coffee cup with a newspaper on his lap. He is wearing a light blue textured denim jacket over a light button-up shirt and blue jeans, looking thoughtfully away to the side. The background is a bright outdoor cafe setting with metal chairs and concrete flooring.

cards.title_html: Kiểu 12 - Đường Phố Châu Âu (Tường Đá Chạm Khắc)
cards.desc_html: A full-body head-to-toe framing of the man standing casually outdoors with one leg crossed over the other and hands in his pockets. He is wearing a dark blue denim jacket over a white shirt, dark blue jeans, and black dress shoes. The background is a highly detailed, ornate stone wall or monument with intricate floral carvings.

cards.title_html: Kiểu 13 - Thuyết Trình Siêu Xe (Kiểu Elon Musk)
cards.desc_html: Framing is a medium full shot, capturing the subject from the thighs up. He is standing upright with arms extended outwards in a welcoming or presenting gesture, wearing a dark velvet suit jacket over a light checkered shirt. Background and lighting feature him standing in front of a sleek red sports car with a large dark red backdrop, illuminated under bright, soft event stage lighting.

cards.title_html: Reference: Podcast Banner (Dark Curtain & Warm Studio Lighting)
cards.desc_html: A medium waist-up framing of the man sitting in a professional podcast studio. He is wearing a dark suit with a white shirt. The background features a dark pleated curtain and warm cinematic studio lighting, with a professional podcast microphone positioned in front of him.

Phân tích góc máy & phong cách: Horizontal 16:9 cinematic YouTube documentary thumbnail. Subject positioned on the left side (side profile), visionary expression. Double exposure effect blending lower torso with futuristic circular tech building and sleek gadgets. Right side is clean white/light grey negative space for typography. High-end corporate tech aesthetic. 4 Phong cách quần áo: Black Turtleneck, White Shirt, Navy Blazer, Charcoal Sweater.

Phân tích góc máy & phong cách: Đen trắng (black and white photography), độ tương phản cao, phông nền trắng trơn. Medium waist-up shot, nhân vật mỉm cười nhẹ và nằm lệch sang bên phải khung hình. Để trống phần lớn không gian bên trái để chèn typography lớn. 4 Phong cách quần áo: Black T-Shirt, Black Polo, Black Shirt, Black Sweater.
